excerpt: You hold the world’s largest bauxite reserves and one of its greatest iron deposits, and the iron began to sail in November 2025.
paras: You hold the world’s largest bauxite reserves and one of its greatest iron deposits, and the iron began to sail in November 2025. Your rivers already light most of your grid. Let the ore pay for the power, the schools and the farms, before the ships carry the windfall away.

Your partners are building with you. In June 2026 the World Bank Group endorsed a new partnership with you, worth more than $3 billion from 2027 to 2033, and approved the same day $102 million for skills and $116 million for commercial agriculture. In 2025 it approved $200 million for water and sanitation and $132.3 million to extend electricity.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Only two in every hundred of you cook with clean fuel, and barely half have electricity. At the last count, in 2019, eighty-three in every hundred of your children reached the end of primary school unable to read a simple text. Your health services reach 43 on the World Health Organization index, less than half of full coverage. Clean energy sets your Coverage today, at 2 out of 100, with reading and health close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Guinea: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Guinean falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: The mountain is moving to the sea. Let every tonne leave something behind for every child.
